name: audio_extract
description: An audio extraction tool that pulls the audio track out of a video file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace (or project/Data/files) using FFmpeg and saves it as mp3 or wav in the Workspace. Use whenever you need audio-only from a video (downloaded via video_download or uploaded) for transcription, listening, or further analysis. Returns the saved audio path plus duration and size metadata.

video_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the source video (e.g. returned by video_download).

audio_format.description: Output audio format: mp3 (default, small) or wav (16k mono, STT-ready).

output_name.description: Optional custom audio file name inside Workspace (single name, extension added if missing).
